title: Engine Slot Headless Law And Offender Fixes
description:
Wave 3 of the approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-single-app-must-joyful-pudding.md, continuing from the closed tickets 26/08/01/HEADLESS-APP-ENGINE-BINARY-COMMAND-PROTOCOL-FOUNDATIONS (Waves 0-1) and 26/08/01/HEADLESS-RUNNER-AND-WORKFLOW-CONFIG-MODEL (Wave 2).

Every app's ⚙️engine constitutional slot is supposed to be pure headless compute with zero UI/rendering dependencies, but four apps violate this today (verified in earlier exploration): puzzle ◻2d's engine depends on wgpu/web-sys/HtmlCanvasElement (a render session, not headless compute); puzzle 🧊️3d's engine is a stateful session with a JSON-string wasm-bindgen method API; trinity ✏️rewrite's and 📜️imperative's engines also depend on web-sys/wasm-bindgen. This ticket fixes all four AND adds the enforceable law (assert_engine_headless, extending assert_constitutional_crates in the plugin SDK's testkit) that catches this class of violation for every future app.

Work packages (file-disjoint, run in parallel):
- WP-3A: puzzle ◻2d — extract the wgpu/web-sys BoardSession (canvas attach/render-frame/pointer handling) out of ✏️s/🔌️plugin/🧩️puzzle/🎛️app/◻2d/🔨️module/⚙️engine into a new framework surface crate (sibling of the existing 🧰️framework/🔨️module/🗺️surface/{🕸️node-graph,🎨️paint,🏔️terrain,🗺️tiled-map} family — this repo's established home for render-engine crates); the engine slot keeps only pure layout/geometry/icon-resolution compute; the 🖱️ui slot depends on the new surface crate for canvas rendering.
- WP-3B: puzzle 🧊️3d — convert Puzzle3dEngine's JSON-string method API (set_scene(&str), apply_brush_placement_json, etc.) to a typed DslOps-derived Puzzle3dEngineCommand enum with binary OpBinary encoding; move the #[wasm_bindgen] wrapper to the ui slot, keep the stateful engine session itself in the engine slot but with wasm-bindgen/serde-wasm-bindgen removed from ITS Cargo.toml.
- WP-3C: trinity ✏️rewrite engine — same wgpu/web-sys/wasm-bindgen extraction pattern as WP-3A/B, scoped to whatever this engine's actual canvas/session code turns out to be (assess first, this may be smaller than puzzle's).
- WP-3D: 📜️imperative engine — same treatment.
- WP-3E (run after WP-3A through 3D land): add assert_engine_headless to the plugin SDK's testkit (extends assert_constitutional_crates, 🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/🔨️module/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, function around line 1975 per earlier exploration — re-locate) — fails if any app's ⚙️engine Cargo.toml depends on wasm-bindgen/serde-wasm-bindgen/wasm-bindgen-futures/web-sys/js-sys/wgpu/winit or the app's own 🖱️ui crate; run it against the whole ✏️s/ tree and confirm it's clean (zero exemptions) now that WP-3A-D have landed.

Full architecture and later waves (per-app fan-out, consolidation, e2e proof, outliers) are in the plan file. This ticket's scope is Wave 3 only.
